usfootballR

The goal of usfootballR is to make American soccer data easy to work with in R. The package has functions to access live play-by-play and box score data from ESPN with shot locations when available.

A scraping and aggregating interface for ESPN’s MLS and NWSL statistics. It provides users with the capability to access the API’s game play-by-plays, box scores, standings and results to analyze the data for themselves.

Data freshness and pipeline status for every SportsDataverse dataset: sportsdataverse.org/status.

Installation

You can install the latest build from R-universe with:

install.packages("usfootballR", repos = c("https://sportsdataverse.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos")))

You can install the development version of usfootballR from GitHub with:

if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("sportsdataverse/usfootballR")
# or, with remotes:
# if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("sportsdataverse/usfootballR")

Quick start 

library(usfootballR)

# MLS play-by-play for a season, from the SportsDataverse data repo
mls_pbp <- load_mls_pbp(2021)

# NWSL schedule for a season
nwsl_schedule <- load_nwsl_schedule(2021)

# Live from ESPN: the MLS scoreboard for a date, and the NWSL standings
espn_mls_scoreboard(season = "20200829")
espn_nwsl_standings(year = 2021)

Companion packages

  • sportyR: draws MLS and NWSL pitches in ggplot2 (geom_soccer()) to plot shot locations on.
  • sdvplotR: team logo plots in ggplot2, gt and reactable across the SportsDataverse leagues.

The SportsDataverse

usfootballR is part of the SportsDataverse, a set of open-source packages for sports data.

Package Sport / Scope
cfbfastR College football
hoopR Men’s basketball (NBA and NCAA)
wehoop Women’s basketball (WNBA and NCAA)
fastRhockey Hockey (NHL and PWHL)
baseballr Baseball (MLB, MiLB, NCAA)
softballR College softball
oddsapiR Sports betting odds
recruitR College football recruiting
usfootballR US soccer
cfbseedR · cfb4th CFB playoff simulation · fourth-down decisions
cfbplotR · sdvplotR · sportyR Logos, colors, tables · playing surfaces
sportsdataverse-R Umbrella R metapackage
sportsdataverse-py · sportsdataverse.js Python and Node.js
